hypothesis: Learning four input-mixing coefficients may fix the diagonal-wave failure while retaining richer quantum outputs on other tasks.
design: 5 fresh data seeds,128 train/256 validation/1024 test, single or4-frequency views. Retrain frozen-encoder baseline, jointly learn W+readout from two starts/config,select checkpoints/configuration by validation only.
optimization: Analytic simulator gradient checked by finite differences;200 L-BFGS-B iterations. Readout regularization from baseline validation; W regularized toward identity. All convergence outcomes logged.
scope: Hybrid trainable encoder: data-dependent gate angles f*(x@W). Additional4 parameters and extra optimization; not a matched-training-cost comparison. No quantum-only expressivity claim.
